name: PubChem Sketcher
tierReason: Its documented workflow creates PubChem query structures and exports them for further publication cleanup in ChemDraw, rather than authoring complete drawing documents.
summary: A browser editor for drawing chemical structures as PubChem search queries and exporting structure files or images.
vendor: National Center for Biotechnology Information, U.S. National Library of Medicine (NIH)

license.text: Free hosted service; public-domain interface and server scripts depend on the proprietary CACTVS interpreter.

engine.rendering: Server-side CACTVS depiction and export; GD renders PNG/GIF images displayed in the browser.

caveats: Editing and rendering require a connection to PubChem servers.
The manual documents only one undoable operation.
Self-hosting requires a proprietary CACTVS interpreter in addition to the public-domain scripts.
